headline: Turkey's BIST 100 Index Gains at Market Open
summary: Turkey's benchmark stock index, the BIST 100, gained 7 points in early morning trading to start the session higher.
why: The BIST 100 index tracks the largest companies listed on Borsa Istanbul, serving as the benchmark for Turkish equity investments.

impacts.name: BIST 100
impacts.why: The Turkish benchmark index opened higher in morning trading.
